94495.title: Call of Water
94495.routeNote: Visit Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan, then Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

94497.title: Call of Water
94497.routeNote: Fill the brown waterskin below Hervdana's waterfall and return to her.

94499.title: Call of Water
94499.routeNote: Fill the red waterskin at Stonewatch Falls in Redridge, then return to Hervdana.

94500.title: Call of Water
94500.routeNote: Fill the blue waterskin at Astranaar in Ashenvale, then return to Hervdana.

94501.title: Call of Water
94501.routeNote: Bring the pure water to Norric in Loch Modan and keep the supplied items.

94502.title: Call of Water
94502.routeNote: Use the sapta and cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond near Moonbrook in Westfall. Follow the shrine instructions.

94503.title: Call of Water
94503.routeNote: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water at the Westfall shrine before leaving.

94505.title: Call of Water
94505.routeNote: Bring the shard back to Norric in Loch Modan for the Water Totem.
